chapter: The levee club and the St. Louis scene
title: His influences: Creath and Armstrong
summary: Dance asks who influenced him. Thomas says Charlie Creath and Louis Armstrong, and that both men knew it.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Just before we move here, Joe, as you sort of, by this time you're a pretty good trumpet player. I mean you've been playing quite a long time.
Well, I thought I was. From what Charlie Creath told me don't I / XXX know. No, I'm in good shape.
Who had you been influenced by chiefly up to this time? I mean was it Louis Armstrong off records or what?

No, I wouldn't say that. I think it was both of them. Now, Pops -- I think it's both of them because I think they were great trumpet players. I wouldn't compare the men. I don't compare the men at all.
No, but I mean when you're sort of young, a young musician, well, everybody is influenced to some extent by what he hears, isn't he?
I was just wondering who you were sort of probably chiefly influenced by at that time. I mean Charlie Creath or ...
At one point by Charlie Creath?
Yeah, the two. Yes, I see. Well, that makes sense.
All right. And they both knew it.
